verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that can summarize, explain, and edit your files. It handles multi-step reading, searching, and writing tasks, and draws on an automatic 'second brain' plus Mind notes and journals, so the core of answering, summarizing, and drafting grounded in your own notes is documented. Nothing in the evidence shows controls for scoping what data the assistant sees, and community comments note the service by nature reads and analyzes all of a user's files. missing for 10: user-facing controls over which files or notes the AI can access, explicit documentation of grounded Q&A with citations, independent hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality.
